title: The History of Women in Logistics
summary: Explore the powerful impact of women in logistics —from ancient trade routes to modern supply chains—and their role in driving innovation and progress.
body_markdown: Women have played integral roles in the history of logistics, from ancient trade routes to modern supply chains. Their contributions have been essential in driving innovation, efficiency, and progress in the field. As we celebrate the achievements of women in logistics during Women’s History Month, let us recognize their invaluable contributions and continue to support and empower women in the industry.
